after.stem: A 45-year-old patient presents to the ED with fever and severe right upper-quadrant pain radiating to the right shoulder tip. Murphy's sign is positive and acute cholecystitis is diagnosed. Which nerve mediates the referred shoulder-tip pain?

evidence.externalFinding: Diaphragmatic peritoneal irritation refers pain to the right shoulder through the right phrenic nerve.
